notice: All institutions, people, documents and events are fictional, newly authored demonstration data. No expert reviews are included. Expected evaluation answers are not part of this corpus.

documents.title: Secretariat planning note
documents.author: Fictional Corridor Secretariat
documents.text: SYNTHETIC. The River Corridor pilot would support shared flood-warning equipment in three districts. Implementation requires Council approval, a Treasury appropriation and participating delegations' written consent. The Secretariat may prepare options but cannot commit funds.

documents.title: Delegation statement
documents.author: Fictional Alder delegation
documents.text: SYNTHETIC. We may consider participation and have agreed to discuss the pilot. Any participation remains subject to our Council's approval and a funded implementation plan. This statement is not a commitment to participate.

documents.title: Regional wire dispatch
documents.author: Fictional Corridor Wire
documents.text: SYNTHETIC. The Alder delegation backed the regional pilot, according to an official familiar with discussions. The delegation's published statement says only that it may consider participation subject to approval. No signed participation instrument was available.

documents.title: Daily bulletin republication
documents.author: Fictional Harbor Daily
documents.text: SYNTHETIC. Reprinted from Corridor Wire: the Alder delegation backed the regional pilot, according to an official familiar with discussions. This article provides no independent interview or verification.

documents.title: Council approval condition
documents.author: Fictional Corridor Council
documents.text: SYNTHETIC. The Council authorizes technical preparation only. Operational launch requires a subsequent recorded vote after the Treasury confirms appropriation and each delegation deposits written consent. The present vote does not approve operational launch.

documents.title: Treasury budget authorization
documents.author: Fictional Treasury Office
documents.text: SYNTHETIC. A ceiling of 120 fictional budget units is authorized for possible pilot expenditure. No appropriation has yet been enacted, no payment has been ordered, and the expenditure ledger records zero disbursement. Authorization must not be reported as spending.

documents.title: Original-language participation note
documents.author: Fictional Belora delegation
documents.translation: Analyst translation: We are ready to examine the proposal, without committing to participate. Any decision depends on the competent Council.
documents.text: SYNTHÉTIQUE. Nous sommes prêts à examiner la proposition, sans nous engager à participer. Toute décision dépend du Conseil compétent.

documents.title: Unresolved institution identity
documents.author: Fictional Secretariat registry clerk
documents.text: SYNTHETIC. The press refers to the Alder Regional Council. The participation condition names the Alder Delegation Council. The registry has not established that these are the same institution. They must remain separate unresolved identities until their legal mandates are checked.

documents.title: Wire correction
documents.author: Fictional Corridor Wire
documents.text: SYNTHETIC. Correction: our earlier description that Alder backed the pilot was too strong. The official described agreement to discuss participation, not acceptance. Council approval, appropriation and written consent remain outstanding. This correction does not alter Belora's separate statement.

documents.title: Withdrawn equipment note
documents.author: Fictional procurement desk
documents.text: SYNTHETIC. An unsigned draft suggested equipment had been ordered. The desk withdrew this note because it concerned a different project. It must not support a current claim of delivered pilot equipment.

documents.title: Options framing
documents.author: Fictional Lumen council
documents.text: SYNTHETIC. The council seeks safer school journeys within a fixed operating budget. Options include the status quo, a shared bus route and subsidized walking escorts. Safety, access for disabled pupils and rural travel time must be evaluated separately; no universal weighted score has been agreed.

documents.title: Pilot observation
documents.author: Fictional school service
documents.text: SYNTHETIC. A two-week bus trial recorded fewer missed journeys among the participating urban pupils. Rural districts did not participate. The observation does not establish effectiveness for rural pupils or pupils requiring accessible vehicles.

documents.title: Accessibility evidence gap
documents.author: Fictional accessibility committee
documents.text: SYNTHETIC. No costed accessible-vehicle proposal or consultation record is available. The committee recommends obtaining both before choosing a transport option. This is a recommendation, not evidence that any option already meets accessibility requirements.

documents.title: Authority handover note
documents.author: Fictional Nera maintenance board
documents.text: SYNTHETIC. The board may schedule inspections but emergency shutdown authority belongs to the municipal safety office. A schedule announcement is not a shutdown order. The next inspection is planned for 12 March subject to technician availability.

documents.title: Inspection outcome
documents.author: Fictional Nera maintenance clerk
documents.text: SYNTHETIC. The planned 12 March inspection was postponed because technicians were unavailable. An inspection took place on 14 March and found a valve requiring replacement. No safety-office shutdown order or completed replacement receipt is recorded.
